cause_quote: The new drag handler returned early on `if (event.pointerType !== "touch" || this.host.mode !== "interact")`, so pen input never entered the scroll gesture.
user_saw: Dragging a stylus across the Control UI Browser panel clicked the remote page instead of scrolling it.
summary: The fix routes pen input through the existing touch gesture handler so drags scroll and taps still click.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and the earlier Browser panel history. The panel previously forwarded wheel events for scrolling, and the new pointer-drag feature shipped with a touch-only guard that prevented pen drags from scrolling or suppressing the subsequent click.
